method: ULM; t-statistic of signed target-weight coefficient, including intercept
background: all non-missing RNA z-scores in each cell line, including zeros
p_values: raw two-sided Student t p-values reconstructed from ULM scores
p_adjusted: native decoupler BH correction across tested TFs separately within each cell line
missing_scores: TF has fewer than min_targets available targets in that cell line
observation_semantics: pooled cell types, not individual cell lines or donor replicates

regulon_cleaning.source_scope: all prior TF sources; source RNA not required

normalization.X: natural log1p of counts normalized to target_sum over the supplied gene subset
normalization.aggregation: sum of provided integer counts across all cells of each cell type
normalization.input_assumption: X contains counts; integer values verified, assay provenance was not supplied
normalization.normalization_background: provided genes only; full-transcriptome library totals are unavailable
normalization.organism_tissue: human heart inferred from source gene IDs and supplied cell annotations
normalization.replication: one pooled profile per cell type; donor variation is not modeled

orientation: genes/TFs in rows, cell lines in columns; cell_summary is cell lines in rows

provenance.reference_workflow: scripts/prepare_cosmos_inputs.R RNA/TF logic, with count normalization before scaling
